data.name: Mahsana
data.gender_notes: Mahsana is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Mahsana is an Arabic name that signifies beauty and piety. It is a combination of 'mah' meaning beauty and 'sana' meaning praise or glorification. The name Mahsana carries the meaning “Beautiful and Pious” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mahsana usually hope their child will grow to embody beautiful and pious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Mahsana is a name that symbolizes the beauty of faith and the importance of praising Allah.
data.etymology: Mahsana belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Beautiful and Pious.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mahsana total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
